## Completion Checklist

- [ ] Tests and lint run; failure, replay and authorization tests included where relevant.
- [ ] No secrets, private keys or raw personal data included.

- [ ] Migration/deployment impact reviewed; cloud/account/schedule changes explicitly approved.

- [ ] Completion evidence linked before closing the issue.
